passage: Last Sunday, my family and I visited the science museum in our city. We arrived at nine in the morning and stayed for three hours. The museum was large and full of interesting things. First, we watched a short film about space. The screen showed stars, planets, and a man on the moon. My son asked many questions, and the guide answered them with a smile. Then we walked to the hall of machines. We touched old cars and pressed big buttons. A robot moved its arms and talked to us in a funny voice. At noon, we ate lunch in the museum cafe. My wife bought some cold juice and a cake. I took many photos of my son with the robot. He looked very happy. On the way home, we talked about space and robots. It was a great day, and we learned a lot.
